title: MACD
description: Fast trend against slow trend, as the gap between two moving averages. When the gap widens the trend is gathering pace.

macd_bps.label: MACD
macd_bps.description: The fast moving average minus the slow one, in basis points. Positive means the trend is up.

signal_bps.label: Signal
signal_bps.description: A smoothed copy of the MACD line, in basis points. The MACD crossing above it is the classic buy read.

histogram_bps.label: Histogram
histogram_bps.description: MACD minus its signal line, in basis points. Growing bars mean the trend is accelerating.
